title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
description: A gifted matchmaker discovers how little she understands the hearts around her.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
editionCredits: An Anonymous Volunteer and David Widger
longDescription: Social expectations, private hopes and the pressure of making a good match give this story its emotional energy. Look for revealing conversations, changing first impressions and the small choices that expose character. It rewards readers who enjoy relationships shaped as much by the surrounding society as by affection.

authorInfo.bio: Jane Austen was an English novelist whose sharp observation of family, money and social expectations reshaped the novel of manners. Her six completed novels include Sense and Sensibility, Emma and Persuasion. Beneath the courtship plots, her wit exposes the choices available to women in her society.
authorInfo.edition: Illustrations by Hugh Thomson; preface by George Saintsbury. Cover reproduced from the source edition.
